# SQLGlot fixture snapshot

These files are extracted from [Polyglot](https://github.com/tobilg/polyglot)
at revision `d5aa0d493c281398c9fdbc6febd3577f10ceac2f` with its
`tools/sqlglot-extract/extract-tests.py` script. Run `make fixtures` to refresh
the snapshot; SQLGlot is test-data tooling only and is not a Go dependency.
